teaser.en: Its name means 'drum maker': the soft, light trunk of this scarlet-flowered tree is hollowed out to make drum bodies.
teaser.sw: Jina lake linamaanisha 'mtengeneza ngoma': shina laini na jepesi la mti huu wenye maua mekundu angavu hufukuliwa ndani ili kutengeneza viunzi vya ngoma.

summary.en: *Mwamba ngoma* is a thorny coral tree of the coastal bush and forest, with three-part leaves and bright scarlet flowers. Its soft, light wood gives the Digo drum bodies, and its name says so.
summary.sw: *Mwamba ngoma* ni mti wenye miiba wa jamii ya *coral tree* wa vichaka na misitu ya pwani, wenye majani ya vijani vitatu na maua mekundu angavu. Mbao zake laini na nyepesi huwapa Wadigo viunzi vya ngoma, na jina lake linasema hivyo.

about.en:
*Mwamba ngoma* is a thorny tree in the bean family, related to the coral trees found across Africa. Each leaf is made of three broad leaflets, and the branches carry prickles. When it flowers, the tree is hung with clusters of vivid scarlet blooms, shaped like the narrow, curved flowers typical of coral trees, which are a favourite of sunbirds.

The wood is the thing to know about. It is soft and light, easy to cut and carve, which is just what a drum maker wants and what most builders do not.
about.sw:
*Mwamba ngoma* ni mti wenye miiba wa jamii ya kunde, jamaa wa miti ya *coral tree* inayopatikana kote Afrika. Kila jani lina vijani vitatu vipana, na matawi yana miiba midogo. Unapochanua, mti hujaa vishada vya maua mekundu angavu, yenye umbo jembamba lililopinda kama ilivyo kawaida kwa maua ya *coral tree*, ambayo hupendwa sana na ndege chozi.

Mbao ndizo jambo la kujua. Ni laini na nyepesi, rahisi kukata na kuchonga, ndicho hasa anachohitaji mtengeneza ngoma na kile ambacho wajenzi wengi hawakitaki.

where.en: Look for it in coastal bushland, open woodland and the edges of coastal forest. It is easiest to spot when it is in flower, when the red clusters stand out against the green and grey of the bush.
where.sw: Utafute katika vichaka vya pwani, mapori wazi na pembezoni mwa misitu ya pwani. Ni rahisi zaidi kuuona unapochanua, wakati vishada vyekundu vinapojitokeza dhidi ya kijani na kijivu cha vichaka.

uses.en: The trunk is hollowed out to make drum bodies. Because the wood is light and works easily, a section of stem can be carved and emptied into a shell, ready to be covered with skin.
uses.sw: Shina hufukuliwa ndani ili kutengeneza viunzi vya ngoma. Kwa kuwa mbao ni nyepesi na rahisi kufanyiwa kazi, kipande cha shina kinaweza kuchongwa na kufukuliwa kuwa kiunzi, tayari kufunikwa kwa ngozi.

culture.en: The name *mwamba ngoma* is read as 'drum maker' (from *ngoma*, drum), and it ties the tree directly to the music of the coast. Drums are at the heart of Digo dances and gatherings, so this is a tree whose wood has long been heard as well as seen.
culture.sw: Jina *mwamba ngoma* linasomwa kama 'mtengeneza ngoma' (kutoka *ngoma*), na linauhusisha mti huu moja kwa moja na muziki wa pwani. Ngoma ni kiini cha densi na mikusanyiko ya Wadigo, kwa hiyo huu ni mti ambao mbao zake kwa muda mrefu zimesikika na pia kuonekana.

names.en: The Digo name is *mwamba ngoma*, also written *mbamba ngoma*. The same name is used in Swahili. No English common name is in wide use; botanists call it *Erythrina sacleuxii*. The Mgombato dictionary gives *mwambangoma* as a different tree, the desert date (*Balanites aegyptiaca*), with the Swahili *mchunju*, so the name may cover more than one tree, or the sources may disagree.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mwamba ngoma*, linaloandikwa pia *mbamba ngoma*. Jina hilo hilo linatumika kwa Kiswahili. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza linalotumika sana; wataalamu wa mimea wanauita *Erythrina sacleuxii*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *mwambangoma* kama mti mwingine, *desert date* (*Balanites aegyptiaca*), wenye jina la Kiswahili *mchunju*, kwa hiyo huenda jina hili linatumika kwa zaidi ya mti mmoja, au vyanzo vinatofautiana.

reason.en: Black mangrove whose hollow trunks are also made into drums
reason.sw: Mkoko wa aina ya black mangrove ambao mashina yake yenye uwazi pia hutengenezwa ngoma

reason.en: Grey mangrove also used for drums
reason.sw: Mchu (grey mangrove), pia hutumika kwa ngoma

reason.en: Another coastal tree used for drums
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa pwani unaotumika kwa ngoma

reason.en: A Balanites; the dictionary links the name mwambangoma to that genus
reason.sw: Balanites; kamusi inaliunganisha jina mwambangoma na jenasi hiyo
